applies_to: UV Angel Clean Air Active upper in-room germicidal UV (GUV) air treatment units, firmware 4.5.5.0, on BACnet IP.
summary: UV Angel Clean Air Active is an upper-room germicidal UV (GUV) air treatment unit with UV bulbs, filters and fans. On BACnet IP it reports bulb and filter life, treatment status and mode, built-in temperature, humidity, CO2, VOC and IAQ readings, and door, lamp and fan faults. The BMS can set the treatment mode and downlight brightness.
notes: The PICS prints no access column; the AOs and BO 19 are marked writable from their descriptions.
BO 19 is printed as 'BO:19' under a Binary Values heading.
Bulb and filter life reset when the bulbs and filters are replaced during maintenance.
No units column; units come from the object names and descriptions.

integration.summary: Write AO 11 to pick standby or one of five speeds and read AI 9 to confirm the mode actually running. Watch BI 12 for treatment status and the door, lamp, fan and end-of-life flags for service needs.
integration.enable: BO 19 BACnet Enabled must stay true; writing false reboots the unit into cloud-connected mode until told to return to BACnet mode.
setup: BACnet IP only; normal or foreign-device mode, BBMD address and subscription lifetime are writable on the Network Port object.
DHCP or static IP; static address, DNS and gateway are writable when DHCP is off.
Device object name and device ID are writable.
gotchas: Writing BO 19 = false takes the unit off BACnet until it is switched back.
